verdict.rationale: Apify's own docs describe a scheduling capability that automatically starts Actors and saved tasks at specific times. Saved tasks can be run multiple times, so recurring scraping jobs fit the documented model. The evidence is a single summary line, though, with no detail on recurrence syntax or schedule management. Missing for 10: documented cron/recurrence and timezone configuration, API/client schedule management, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can schedule scraping jobs to run automatically at specific times

citations.quote: Automatically start Actors and saved tasks at specific times.
Tasks are saved in the Apify platform and can be run multiple times.
